headline: Ghana generates 7.8 billion cedis under sliding-scale mining royalty regime
summary: Ghanaian President John Mahama announced that the government collected 7.8 billion Ghanaian cedis in royalties from large-scale gold producers since implementing a sliding-scale mining framework.
why: Adjustable mineral royalties allow resource-rich nations to capture windfall state revenues during prolonged commodity price upswings.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Increased fiscal collections from gold miners expand government non-debt tax revenues.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
